1927, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 36
Rose Marg. H. (ickey) 21 of Lima Ohio, after one year in the Novit- iate with SSrs of Charity Mt. St Jos becomes "lonesome" and discon- tented, etc - her Mother continually pleading for her return. She left, came to Detroit, fell unfortunately and is now in a home pro- viding for wayward girls; she thinks she can marry the man when his wife dies.
Febr. 17th Demended since 6 month old. Paul Martin (now 21) in LePiere, Mich. Institution 12 years has been without the use of reason - seemingly blighted when 6 months old, then a most promising baby. He does not know anyone even his mother, whose heart aches with maternal sympathy whenever she visits him - enrolled To-day for two years.
Anna Schram, 30, of 99 Yellow-Stone Ave (City) operated on for gall- stones Dec. 18th - then Jan. 20 another operation - double for ab- sesses on liver declared as absolutely hopeless, then in dying con- dition. Her sister has Enrolled her Jan. 23 and To-day anounces her as already back home P.S. One only case besides of similar gravity in Grace Hospital died after operation 5 yrs ago.
March 20th Ellen Grace Marie Snitgen, 3 weeks old To-day has what doctors call "defectia spinae" is declared incurable of this very serious spinal trouble. She is enrolled To-day her parents promising more frequent Communion
March 31 Mrs. Theresa Schafer, 56, Fowler, Mich. operated on for cancer of womb. Doctors were preparing for further operation when, after be- ing enrolled in S.M. Ass'n, they were surprised that no further op- eration seemed necessary.
April 8 .. . Duncan Rule (non Catholic) 34, Taylor Ave. near Byron, dying of diabetes & perenitis enrolled doubly - 1st by phone last January, -- He is working now.
April 9 Henry Marcinkowski, 9 of 7870 Girardin Ave. Detroit, threatened with blindness in right eye - specialists want to take it out. He is enrolled perpetually this evening.
April 14 (Holy Thursday) Kathleen Molloy 3, of 1575 Princeton beautiful child intelligent and bright has never spoken enrolled To-day.
May 14th 3 p.m. At 10.30 phone message says: "Please enroll Alphie de Bour- assa in the Mass Associ'n right away. He is reported dying in Ana- conda, Wash. We will be out this afternoon and pay up."
